top5.title: Jensen Huang steps down as Nvidia CEO
top5.description: Jensen Huang, Nvidia’s co-founder and CEO since 1993, resigned after acknowledging affairs with female executives linked to the company. Colette Kress becomes interim CEO, while Nvidia stock fell as much as 14%.
top5.why: Jensen Huang’s reported departure from Nvidia, accompanied by a sharp stock decline, would represent a major leadership and market shock for the company at the center of the AI-chip boom.

top5.title: U.S. Data Center Electricity Demand Is Growing Ten Times Faster Than the Grid
top5.description: U.S. data center electricity demand has increased by about 19% annually since 2000, compared with 2% for grid capacity. According to Howden, data centers may need to obtain up to 58% of their electricity off-grid by 2030.
top5.why: Data-center electricity demand is growing far faster than grid capacity, making power availability an increasingly decisive constraint on AI infrastructure, investment and regional planning.

top5.title: Europe wants to ban dark patterns and loot boxes for minors
top5.description: The proposed Digital Fairness Act targets, among other things, subscriptions that are difficult to cancel, addictive design, ads targeting minors, and personalized pricing. Fines could reach 6% of global turnover.
top5.why: The EU’s proposed Digital Fairness Act could impose broad restrictions on dark patterns, targeted advertising and personalized pricing, with fines of up to 6% of global turnover.

top5.title: Google launches Gemini Decision 1, a specialized AI model
top5.description: Google has launched Gemini Decision 1, an affordable model designed to answer binary, multiple-choice, or rating questions. It costs $0.10 per million input tokens and also provides a confidence score.
top5.why: Google’s low-cost Gemini Decision 1 model could materially reduce the cost of classification and evaluation workloads while intensifying competition in enterprise AI.

top5.title: AlphaGenome 2 links genetic mutations to cell types
top5.description: Google DeepMind has launched AlphaGenome 2, a model that predicts the effect of genetic variants on specific types of human cells. Trained on more than 107 million cell profiles, it identified about 30% of causal variants, up from 16% previously.
top5.why: AlphaGenome 2’s improved ability to link genetic mutations to specific cell types could accelerate drug discovery and the understanding of disease mechanisms.
